arxiv-2203-04728.title: Dynamic mode decomposition as an analysis tool for time-dependent partial differential equations The authors would like to acknowledge the financial support of the Slovenian Research Agency (ARRS) research core funding No. P2-0095 and the Young Researcher program PR-10468.
arxiv-2203-04728.creator: Miha Rot 1 2 , Martin Horvat 3 , Gregor Kosec 2
arxiv-2203-04728.description: Abstract The time-dependent fields obtained by solving partial differential equations in two and more dimensions quickly overwhelm the analytical capabilities of the human brain. A meaningful insight into the temporal behaviour can be obtained by using scalar reductions, which, however, come with a loss of spatial detail.

arxiv-2206-06688.title: Inference of neutrino nature and Majorana CP phases from 𝟎 ​ ν ​ β ​ β {\bf 0}\mathbold{\nu\beta\beta} decays with inverted mass ordering
arxiv-2206-06688.creator: Guo-yuan Huang, Newton Nath
arxiv-2206-06688.description: Abstract Whether the neutrino mass ordering is normal or inverted remains an experimentally open issue in neutrino physics. The knowledge of neutrino mass ordering has great importance for neutrinoless double-beta ( 0 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 0\nu\beta\beta ) decay experiments, which can establish the nature of massive neutrinos, i.e., whether they are Dirac or Majorana fermions.

arxiv-2301-00734.title: Nonlinear Non-Hermitian Landau-Zener-Stückelberg-Majorana interferometry
arxiv-2301-00734.creator: Xin Wang, H. D. Liu, L. B. Fu
arxiv-2301-00734.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xin Wang, H. D. Liu, L. B. Fu. In this work, we have studied the non-Hermitian nonlinear LZSM interferometry in a non-Hermitian N-body interacting boson system in which the non-Hermicity is from the nonreciprocal tunnelings between the bosons. By using the mean-field approximation and projective Hilbert space, the effect of nonreciprocity and nonlinearity on the energy spectrum, the dynamics, and the formation of the interference fringes have been studied. arxiv-2305-10124.title: Principal Uncertainty Quantification with Spatial Correlation for Image Restoration Problems
arxiv-2305-10124.creator: Omer Belhasin, Yaniv Romano, Daniel Freedman, Ehud Rivlin, Michael Elad
arxiv-2305-10124.description: Abstract Uncertainty quantification for inverse problems in imaging has drawn much attention lately. Existing approaches towards this task define uncertainty regions based on probable values per pixel, while ignoring spatial correlations within the image, resulting in an exaggerated volume of uncertainty.

arxiv-2410-15258.title: Stabilization for a degenerate wave equation with time-varying delay in the boundary control input
arxiv-2410-15258.creator: Menglan Liao
arxiv-2410-15258.description:
A 2024 arXiv research paper by Menglan Liao. Abstract:
A degenerate wave equation with time-varying delay in the boundary control input is considered. The well-posedness of the system is established by applying the semigroup theory. The boundary stabilization of the degenerate wave equation is concerned and the uniform exponential decay of solutions is obtained by combining the energy estimates with suitable Lyapunov functionals and an integral inequality under suitable conditions. Keywords:
degenerate wave equation; time-varying delay; stabilization; exponential decay. MSC(2020):
35L80; 93D23; 93D15.

arxiv-2503-12166.title: The “recognition,” “belief,” and “action” regarding conspiracy theories: An empirical study using large-scale samples from Japan and the United States
arxiv-2503-12166.creator: Taichi Murayama, Dongwoo Lim, Akira Matsui, Tsukasa Tanihara
arxiv-2503-12166.description: Abstract Conspiracy theories present significant societal challenges, shaping political behavior, eroding public trust, and disrupting social cohesion. Addressing their impact requires recognizing that conspiracy engagement is not a singular act but a multi-stage process involving distinct cognitive and behavioral transitions.

arxiv-2503-13114.title: Symmetric channel verification for purifying noisy quantum channels
arxiv-2503-13114.creator: Kento Tsubouchi, Yosuke Mitsuhashi, Ryuji Takagi, Nobuyuki Yoshioka
arxiv-2503-13114.description: Abstract Symmetry inherent in quantum states has been widely used to reduce the effect of noise in quantum error correction and a quantum error-mitigation technique known as symmetry verification. However, these symmetry-based techniques exploit symmetry in quantum states rather than quantum channels , limiting their application to cases where the entire circuit shares the same symmetry.

arxiv-2507-03612.title: Multi-Hop Reasoning for Question Answering with Hyperbolic Representations
arxiv-2507-03612.creator: Simon Welz, Lucie Flek, Akbar Karimi
arxiv-2507-03612.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Simon Welz, Lucie Flek, Akbar Karimi. Hyperbolic representations are effective in modeling knowledge graph data which is prevalently used to facilitate multi-hop reasoning. However, a rigorous and detailed comparison of the two spaces for this task is lacking. In this paper, through a simple integration of hyperbolic representations with an encoder-decoder model, we perform a controlled and comprehensive set of experiments to compare the capacity of hyperbolic space versus Euclidean space in multi-hop reasoning.

arxiv-2509-04026.title: Excluding a Ladder as an Induced Minor in Graphs Without Induced Stars
arxiv-2509-04026.creator: Mujin Choi, Sebastian Wiederrecht
arxiv-2509-04026.description: Abstract A k k -ladder is the graph obtained from two disjoint paths, each with k k vertices, by joining the i i th vertices of both paths with an edge for each i ∈ { 1 , … , k } i\in\{1,\ldots,k\} .

pmc-10672898.creator: Petra Lovecká, Gabriela Kroneislová, Zuzana Novotná, Jana Röderová, Kateřina Demnerová, Roberto Defez
pmc-10672898.description: Modern technologies can satisfy human needs only with the use of large quantities of fertilizers and pesticides that are harmful to the environment. For this reason, it is possible to develop new technologies for sustainable agriculture. The process could be carried out by using endophytic microorganisms with a (possible) positive effect on plant vitality.

pmc-10748188.title: Hybridization Effect on Interlaminar Bond Strength, Flexural Properties, and Hardness of Carbon–Flax Fiber Thermoplastic Bio-Composites
pmc-10748188.creator: Mohsen Bahrami, Juan Carlos del Real, Mahoor Mehdikhani, José Antonio Butenegro, Juana Abenojar, Miguel Ángel Martínez
pmc-10748188.description: Hybridizing carbon-fiber-reinforced polymers with natural fibers could be a solution to prevent delamination and improve the out-of-plane properties of laminated composites. Delamination is one of the initial damage modes in composite laminates, attributed to relatively poor interlaminar mechanical properties, e.g., low interlaminar strength and fracture toughness.

pmc-12428628.title: Psidium guajava Leaves n-Hexane Fraction Antibacterial Activity and the Inhibition of Gene Expression of gtfB and gtfC in the Combination Streptococcus mutans ATCC 25175 and Veillonella parvula ATCC 10790T
pmc-12428628.creator: Ame Suciati Setiawan, Anas Subarnas, Ariadna Adisatya Djais, Tiana Milanda, Solachudin Jauhari Arief Ichwan
pmc-12428628.description: BackgroundOral biofilm is an extracellular polymeric matrix produced by Streptococcus mutans as the early colonizer in the formation of an oral biofilm. Glucosyltransferase (Gtfs) enzyme is a virulence factor for S. mutans in biofilm that is resistant to antibacterial agents. Veillonella parvula influences S. mutans to increased quantities of Gtfs, thereby accelerating the growth of oral biofilms.

pmc-12492045.title: The Role of 1,2-Palladium Migration/Insertion on C(sp3)–H Functionalization
pmc-12492045.creator: Mohammad Sadegh Karimtabar, Yasin Mohammadkhani, Mohammad Mahdavi, Parviz Rashidi Ranjbar
pmc-12492045.description: Selective functionalization of C­(sp3)–H bonds remains challenging yet crucial for researchers. A frequently used approach by chemists to tackle this challenge involves leveraging 1,2-metal migration/insertion, which enables the selective activation and cleavage of a specific C­(sp3)–H bond adjacent to or distant from the directing group.

pmc-12567640.title: Albendazole Detection at a Nanomolar Level Through a Fabry–Pérot Interferometer Realized via Molecularly Imprinted Polymers
pmc-12567640.creator: Ines Tavoletta, Ricardo Oliveira, Filipa Sequeira, Catarina Cardoso Novo, Luigi Zeni, Giancarla Alberti, Nunzio Cennamo, Rogerio Nunes Nogueira, Patrick Wagner
pmc-12567640.description: Albendazole (ABZ) is a broad-spectrum anthelmintic drug whose residual presence in food and the environment raises public health concerns, requiring rapid and sensitive methods of detection. In this work, a sensitive Fabry–Pérot interferometer (FPI) probe was fabricated by realizing a cavity located at the tip of a single-mode optical fiber core with a molecularly imprinted polymer (MIP) for ABZ detection.

pmc-13224281.title: Evolving landscape of haemophilia care in India: Balancing innovation, access, and sustainability
pmc-13224281.creator: Uday Yanamandra, Neeraj Sidharthan, Joseph M. John
pmc-13224281.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). s such as emicizumab, and early advances in gene therapy has created a moment of unprecedented possibility. Yet, India’s progress remains uneven, marked by pockets of excellence, persistent gaps, and the urgent need for system-level strengthening. This editorial synthesises these evolving trends, with particular emphasis on real-world insights from clinicians, State programmes, and patient organisations who are shaping the next chapter of haemophilia care in India.
